rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered a bodily injury on the policyholder's premises due to an icy condition, which is a classic premises liability scenario covered under homeowners liability coverage.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered a fractured wrist after slipping on ice on the policyholder's front walkway during an ice storm last week. Parents are pursuing medical claims. This is a high-severity pediatric premises liability claim requiring immediate adjuster attention.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped on ice and fell
case_facts.medical_involvement: Wrist fracture, parents discussing medical bills
